prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: opaque background depth plate for a high quality 2D side-view fighting videogame, original Yautja clan setting 'Balcon du Roi de la Chasse'. This is an ORIGINAL lore-compatible extension, NOT a claim of a canonical film location. Reference image 1 is a production artist's homestead design; borrow only its layered rock canopies, low brutal alien structures and practical integrated technology, never copy its text or exact building.
Composition: panoramic landscape 1536x1024 or wider; camera level looking horizontally across a distant canyon, front-facing stage view, no Dutch angle. The entire image is DISTANT landscape and mid-distance architecture. NO nearby floor, NO playable platform, NO horizontal foreground ledge or foot-contact line. Lowest quarter contains continuing distant canyon haze/rock depth, not black void. Keep central lower 60% visually calm for later separate fighters and modules. No foreground columns framing the image.
Scene: an elevated clan overlook across a harsh arid rocky coastal chasm at sunset. Tilted fractured stone plates, dry basalt ridges and distant ocean glints. A small cluster of low heavy Yautja clan dwellings under broad overlapping stone slab canopies; ribbed dark metallic supports, curved weathered alien reinforcement, taut cable stays, practical amber recessed light slots. A larger clan meeting lodge is embedded into a far cliff on the upper right, its balcony small in the distance. Sophisticated hunter-clan machinery fused with tough geological shelter. Several distant landing scars but no spacecraft or people.
Style: detailed realistic hand-painted videogame environment, cinematic dusty copper and smoky basalt palette, spatial atmospheric layering, restrained warm highlights, richly observed rough stone and alien alloy, crisp architecture farther away but subdued contrast behind fighter silhouettes. Avoid generic fantasy fortress, gothic pointed arches, cathedral spires, medieval castles, statues, giant mask faces, gods, human heraldry, torches, braziers, unsupported floating objects, human windows, text, labels, UI, watermarks. No people, animals or silhouettes. Do not paint the combat floor.
